releases.title: v0.9.1 - AI Intelligence & Real-time Collaboration
releases.description: This release introduces a modular AI prompt architecture, live dashboard updates via WebSockets, and a session-based activity feed for enhanced team collaboration and query reliability.

releases.title: v0.9.0 - The Cloud-Native Evolution & Drizzle Migration
releases.description: A milestone release marking the transition to a robust, cloud-native architecture with Neon PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, and significant performance optimizations for the global deployment environment.

releases.title: v0.8.8 - Premium Visual Identity & Enterprise Cloud
releases.description: A comprehensive visual identity overhaul introducing tier-based dynamic theming, enterprise-grade cloud integrations with BYOM (Bring Your Own Model) support, and improved documentation for cloud providers.

releases.title: v0.8.7 - Global Settings System
releases.description: Complete overhaul of the application settings system, introducing a unified global store, functional AI parameters, and granular control over notifications, data views, and queries.

releases.title: v0.8.6 - Dashboard Collaborative Chat
releases.description: This release enhances dashboard collaboration with @mentions, AI-powered queries, in-app notifications, table elements, image sharing, and smart caching.

releases.title: v0.8.5 - Spreadsheet Collaboration
releases.description: This release introduces full real-time collaboration for spreadsheets, complete with presence indicators, edit synchronization, and an enhanced sharing system for teams.

releases.title: v0.8.4 - Tool-Based AI Mode
releases.description: This release transforms the AI mode from a formula-centric approach to a powerful, tool-based system capable of data analysis, formatting, calculations, and query optimization across both spreadsheet and SQL editors.

releases.title: v0.8.3 - The Desktop Awakening
releases.description: This release brings the power of Local AI and Native Desktop integrations to Pegasus, marking a major evolution in privacy and performance.

releases.title: Query History & AI Model Updates
releases.description: Release v0.8.2 - Enhanced query history management, updated AI model support (Gemini 2.5/3.0, OpenAI o1/4.5), and improved usage tracking accuracy.

releases.title: Connection-Scoped Tabs & Responsive UI
releases.description: Release v0.8.1 - Improved tab management with connection isolation, refactored API services, and enhanced responsive design for split-screen usage.

releases.title: Desktop Application & Architecture Overhaul
releases.description: Launching the official Pegasus Desktop app alongside a massive architectural migration to Pinia and a more robust authentication system.

releases.title: Documentation Hub & AI Intelligence Upgrades
releases.description: Unified documentation experience, smarter AI conversations with markdown support, and refined navigation for a cleaner interface.

releases.title: Improved Data Processing & Workspace Persistence
releases.description: Major overhaul of Excel parsing logic for complex spreadsheets, combined with connection-aware workspace persistence and enhanced data preview tools.

releases.title: Architectural Improvements
releases.description: Major refactor introducing centralized API client for improved reliability and maintainability.

releases.title: AI Chat & UX Enhancements
releases.description: A major overhaul of the Chat interface for improved usability, cleaner data presentation, and smarter AI interactions.

releases.title: Pro Subscription & Performance
releases.description: Introduced Stripe-powered Pro subscriptions, McMaster-Carr inspired performance optimizations, and improved system-wide error handling.

releases.title: Visualization & Query Intelligence Upgrade
releases.description: A comprehensive update improving SurrealDB query generation, introducing client-side aggregation for complex metrics, and enhancing automatic chart visualization capabilities.

releases.title: Chat Architecture & Visibility Hotfixes
releases.description: Hotfixes to improve the reliability of the new collaboration features, ensuring messages are saved correctly and the chat UI is fully accessible.

releases.title: Real-time Collaboration & Performance
releases.description: A major update introducing real-time collaboration features (Chat, Live Cursors) and significant performance optimizations for a fluid experience.

releases.title: Shared Dashboards & Excel Parsing Improvements
releases.description: Introducing a dedicated view for shared dashboards and robust improvements to Excel file parsing and user search.

releases.title: Dashboard Elements & Privacy Controls
releases.description: Major dashboard enhancements introducing rich text blocks, file attachments, and comprehensive privacy controls with a powerful markdown editor.

releases.title: AI Response Quality & Chat Formatting Improvements
releases.description: Major improvements to AI query generation, response formatting, and chat message display quality.

releases.title: AI Intelligence & UX Refinements
releases.description: Enhanced AI query generation with world knowledge, improved visualization workflows, and better data presentation.

releases.title: Collaboration & Smart Notes
releases.description: Introducing real-time collaboration features, smart annotations, and the foundation for the 'Git for Data' workflow.

releases.title: Engine Refactoring & Critical Checks
releases.description: Significant architectural improvements to the spreadsheet engine and critical bug fixes for data integrity.

releases.title: Dashboard Editor Improvements & Quick Creation
releases.description: Enhanced the dashboard editing experience with a wider modal layout, quick dashboard creation from visualizations, and improved validation.

releases.title: Advanced Dashboard Customization
releases.description: Introduced a comprehensive editor for dashboard elements featuring real-time preview, advanced color palette generation, and detailed data annotation capabilities.

releases.title: Vercel Deployment & Visualization Enhancements
releases.description: Critical deployment fixes for Vercel serverless environment and major improvements to dashboard visualization capabilities with user-controlled chart types.

releases.title: Excel Engine & Experimental Features
releases.description: Major release introducing a custom-built Excel-like spreadsheet engine with AI-powered formula generation and a comprehensive experimental features system.

releases.title: Query Tab Isolation & Bug Fixes
releases.description: Improved query tab management with SSMS-style isolation and critical bug fixes for formula handling.

releases.title: Support System & Dashboard Sharing
releases.description: Initial release with support page, feedback system, and dashboard sharing capabilities.
